page_title: LIV 3-1 BOU | Liverpool v Bournemouth 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Bournemouth get a corner.

90+4' Hamed Junior Traore (Bournemouth) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.

90+2' Hamed Junior Traore (Bournemouth) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alisson. The linesman makes the right call and Bournemouth will have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Thomas Bramall saw the whole situation. Bournemouth have a free kick from a promising distance.
86' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) replacing Mohamed Salah.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Luis Diaz walks off the pitch to be replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
84' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Marcos Senesi is replaced by Hamed Junior Traore (Bournemouth).
84' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is first to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but he misdirects his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
84' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Alisson.
83' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
80' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
76' Here comes a substitution. Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Joe Rothwell.
76' The substitution is prepared. David Brooks joins the action as a substitute, replacing Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
76' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Harvey Elliott replaces Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
76' Here is a change. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Joe Gomez.
72' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) commits a foul and Thomas Bramall immediately signals a free kick. Liverpool get a free kick.
71' The linesman raises his flag. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.

70' CHANCE! Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
66' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
65' A pass into the box finds Diogo Jota (Liverpool) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Neto denies him.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth) will replace Ryan Christie.
63' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Jaidon Anthony will be replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
63' It's time for a substitution. Wataru Endo (Liverpool) comes on in place of Cody Gakpo.
62' 3 - 1 Goal! Diogo Jota (Liverpool) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:1.
62' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Neto is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
62' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

58' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) receives his marching orders. Even some of the opposing players are surprised with the strictness of the referee's decision, but he has to leave the pitch immediately.
57' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
53' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Neto makes a simple save.

51' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) controls a rebound and tries to catch the keeper out from long range, but it's a poor effort that sails well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
51' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Diogo Jota (Liverpool) goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
51' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
50' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.

49' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
48' The foul by Diogo Jota (Liverpool) was seen by Thomas Bramall who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick to Bournemouth.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.

45+4' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
45+4' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will take a corner kick.
45+3' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Alisson as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.

45+3' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.

45+1' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
45+1' Now Liverpool have a corner.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.

45' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Neto guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Some great controlled play and passing from Liverpool. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
41' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
36' 2 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has the simplest of tasks to roll the ball into an empty net from close range after a rebound left the keeper stranded. 2:1.
36' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) blows a penalty kick! His shot wasn't powerful enough and that allowed the goalkeeper to make a great save to keep the ball from crossing the goal line!
36' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
35' Neto (Bournemouth) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
35' Thomas Bramall blows his whistle and signals a foul after Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down. The referee gives a penalty kick to Liverpool!!
34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
33' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Thomas Bramall blows for a foul after Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
30' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) plays a lovely through ball to Mohamed Salah, but he can't beat Neto and loses the ball.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
26' Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
25' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
21' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
20' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
18' PENALTY APPEAL after Diogo Jota (Liverpool) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
16' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
15' Liverpool have a corner.
13' It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.

13' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Neto pulls off a brilliant save. The referee points to the corner flag and Liverpool will take a corner.
10' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Alisson (Liverpool).
9' Alisson (Liverpool) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Bramall had an easy-decision to make.
7' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
6' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to send the ball in.
5' The resulting corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is cleared.

3' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
1' Bournemouth have a goal ruled out for offside!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Liverpool will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Thomas Bramall.
